title: Numerical Linear Algebra Lab
description: Interactive companion to Chapter 7 of Leon, Linear Algebra with Applications: floating-point numbers and machine epsilon, Gaussian elimination and its cost, pivoting in t-digit arithmetic, matrix norms and condition numbers, Householder and Givens transformations, the power method and the QR algorithm.
lede: Computers round. See which numbers a floating-point system can hold, watch cancellation destroy digits, run Gaussian elimination in 3-digit arithmetic with and without pivoting, perturb an ill-conditioned system, reflect vectors with Householder matrices, and find eigenvalues by iteration.
